rows.note: Use 單位 for a standard measurement or for one apartment in a housing development; it is the all-purpose choice in these contexts.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daan1 wai2 jau5 saam1 gaan1 fong2

rows.note: Use 部隊 for an organized operational group, especially a military or police unit.

example.english: This unit is responsible for guarding the bridgehead.
example.traditional: 呢支部隊負責守住個橋頭。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 bou6 deoi6 fu6 zaak3 sau2 zyu6 go3 kiu4 tau4

rows.note: Use 單元 for a self-contained topic or module in a course, and in technical contexts for a functional computer module.

example.english: This course has a unit on computer security.
example.traditional: 呢個課程有一個講電腦保安嘅單元。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 jau5 jat1 go3 gong2 din6 nou5 bou2 on1 ge3 daan1 jyun4

rows.note: Use 部機 when referring to one machine, appliance, or other piece of powered equipment.

example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 hou2 haan1 din6
